description: Real-world production transmission templates that combine one bundled 3D LUT (from filter_manifest.json), one FxPreset (from com.apexstudio.app.data.fx.FxPreset), and one TransitionType (from com.apexstudio.app.data.gl.TransitionEngine.Companion.TransitionType). Each entry is validated against the live catalog at load time so a renamed LUT / FX / transition is reported as a missing-id warning instead of crashing the editor.

templates.name: Golden Hour Voyage
templates.description: Warm travel-vlog colour with a soft film-grain haze and gentle cross-dissolves between clips. Matches the cinematic_lut preset 'golden_hour' at 0.85 intensity.

templates.name: Tokyo Neon Run
templates.description: Saturated magenta/cyan grade with chromatic aberration and glitch transitions — straight from the neon_purple LUT, finished with the chromatic split FX shader.

templates.name: Noir Detective
templates.description: High-contrast charcoal monochrome with scanline FX and a directional wipe. Drives the noir_classic LUT with scanlines stacked on top for a CRT-monitor finish.

templates.name: VHS Memory
templates.description: Authentic VHS warmth with the VHS FX shader (sync wobble + chromatic split + phosphor scanline) and a slide transition for that 90s home-video feel.

templates.name: Sunset Blockbuster
templates.description: Big-screen warm sunset grade (sunset_gold LUT) with a vignette FX and cross-dissolves. Built for travel montages and reveal shots.

templates.name: Ocean Drive
templates.description: Cool ocean-blue grade with a soft blur FX and a directional wipe. Perfect for coastal B-roll, drone shots over water, and serene travel edits.

templates.name: Forest Mystic
templates.description: Deep forest-green grade with film-grain FX for a moody nature-doc feel. Cross-dissolve transitions keep the cut invisible — let the colour do the work.

templates.name: Cyber Glitch 2088
templates.description: Matrix-green digital grade with full glitch FX and zoom-blur transitions. The most aggressive preset in the catalog — high intensity, fast cuts.
